For this project, our team utilized data from Zillow about the California housing market. We primarily looked at average days on the market, median sale prices over time, average listing prices, median mortgage rate, and median house prices across California.

**How did median home sale prices change in California before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic?**

Why this question is interesting: We all know that Covid had an impact on the housing market, but for those of us who were not in a place to worry about buying or selling a house for whatever reason during this time, it may be difficult to fully understand the impact that Covid had. Answering this question gives us a concrete visual of how California housing prices were affected by Covid.

**Which California cities have the highest average listing prices?**

Why this question is interesting: A state as large as California has hundreds cities with varying populations and geographical characteristics. This question helps us look into how different factors affect housing prices, and allows us to compare these affects to other parts of the United States.

**What relationship exists between mortgage interest rates for single-family homes with a 20% down payment and median single-family home prices across California cities?**

Why this question is interesting: This question showcases how expensive it is/ would be to buy a house in California, and even if you aren't planning to move, it still provides some perspective on the cost of living in other areas, like Fayetteville, and a general idea of how mortgage price and house price might be correlated elsewhere.

Excel Analysis: To answer this question, we uploaded the relevant data into an excel workbook, and used that data to create a dual-axis scatter plot showing how median mortgage rate and median house price relate to eachother across 26 different cities in California. Each Y-axis was then re-formatted to make the data easily readable.
